justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/wifi/NetworkType.java and android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/wifi/WifiConfigManager.java. The package contains only 2 classes / 339 total lines: a 45-line enum for mapping network types and a 294-line AsyncTask focused narrowly on enabling Wi-Fi and building/applying WifiConfiguration objects for WEP/WPA/WPA2-EAP/open networks. The responsibility is cohesive and small, with no evidence of a large, multi-responsibility package or broad centralization.
